MACD MACD

Moving Average Convergence Divergence: a momentum indicator built from two moving averages and a signal line.

हिंदी में: MACD

मूविंग एवरेज कन्वर्जेंस डाइवर्जेंस: दो मूविंग एवरेज और एक सिग्नल रेखा से बना मोमेंटम इंडिकेटर।

How it is used in the lessons

MACD: the difference between a 12-period and a 26-period EMA, with a 9-period signal line.

From Technical Analysis

Momentum indicators (RSI, MACD, stochastic): measure the speed of price moves and whether they are speeding up or slowing down.
